== History ==
Founded 1998 by Valla,Muppstah and Hanky as a lan clan.
Resurrected 1999 and recruited Znappe.
Participated in Challenge-Smackdown Season 1 and disbanded shortly after.
Resurrected once again to participate at CotsLan 2000 with Deathwing,CykloP, Emin and RuneMan joining the ranks.
